answer: Put Registered door supervisor incident log with door supervisors verification at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. A farm running 779 aliases would need 779 separate proofs, each costing about 107 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The anchor sits in the mechanism itself, the pigment sits in the price of faking it, and the yarrow sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
